title: A study in several hospitals testing a liquid form of gabapentin in children aged 3 months to under 18 years who have long-lasting pain caused by damage or disease in the body's pain-signaling system or by an over-sensitive pain system, or a mix of the two.
official: Multi-center, single-arm, adaptive, prospective cohort study to evaluate the pharmacokinetics, efficacy and safety of gabapentin liquid formulation in children from 3 months to less than 18 years of age experiencing moderate to severe chronic neuropathic, nociplastic or mixed pain.
summary: Main objective: To assess the efficacy of gabapentin for the treatment of moderate to severe chronic neuropathic, nociplastic or mixed pain in children from 3 months to less than 18 years of age assessed by the difference in average pain scores among baseline and the end of the maintenance period.
conditions:
Paediatric population with chronic continuous or recurrent neuropathic, nociplastic or mixed pain. 
Or 
Neuralgia (as condition reported in MedDRA)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female aged 3 months to less than 18 years at screening.
2. Written informed consent from parent(s)/legal guardian(s) and assent from the participant, where applicable and according to local regulations.
3. Diagnosis of chronic neuropathic, nociplastic or mixed pain, based on clinical assessment and predefined protocol criteria.
4. Chronic pain persisting for >3 months.
5. Moderate to severe pain, defined as an average pain intensity score ≥4/10 during the baseline assessment period.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pain duration >3 year.
2. Participation in another interventional clinical trial.
3. Pregnancy or lactation.
4. Previous enrolment in, or screening failure for, the current study.
5. Previous failure of gabapentin treatment for neuropathic pain.
6. History of epilepsy (except febrile seizures).
7. Significant respiratory impairment or sleep apnoea syndrome.
8. Significant cognitive impairment or psychiatric conditions that may interfere with pain assessment.
9. History of suicidal ideation or behaviour
10. Severe renal or hepatic impairment.
11. Known hypersensitivity to gabapentin or any component of the investigational product.
12. Use of prohibited concomitant medications.
